DEFINE INSTRUMENT SANS_instrument(L1 = 3.926, A1w = 0.030, A1h = 0.02, S6 = 0.006, A2 = 0.006, Lmin = 1, Lmax = 14)
DECLARE
  TRACE

COMPONENT lmon1 = L_monitor(nL=140, filename="lmon1.dat", xmin=-0.04, xmax=0.04, ymin=-0.03, ymax=0.03, Lmin=0.0, Lmax=17.0, restore_neutron=1) AT (0.0, 0.0, 3.698) RELATIVE isis_source 
COMPONENT psd1 = PSD_monitor(nx=100, ny=100, filename="psd1.dat", xmin=-0.05, xmax=0.05, ymin=-0.05, ymax=0.05, restore_neutron=1) AT (0.0, 0.0, 3.699) RELATIVE isis_source 
COMPONENT bender1 = Guide_gravity(w1=.0355, h1=.020, w2=.0355, h2=.020, l=0.3245, nslit=9, d=.0005, mleft=1, mright=3, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 3.7) RELATIVE isis_source ROTATED (0.0, 0.137099, 0.0) RELATIVE isis_source

COMPONENT bender7 = Guide_gravity(w1=.0355, h1=.020, w2=.0355, h2=.020, l=0.3245, nslit=9, d=.0005, mleft=1, mright=3, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 0.325) RELATIVE bender6 ROTATED (0.0, 0.1375099, 0.0) RELATIVE bender6
COMPONENT bender8 = Guide_gravity(w1=.0355, h1=.020, w2=.0355, h2=.020, l=0.3245, nslit=9, d=.0005, mleft=1, mright=3, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 0.325) RELATIVE bender7 ROTATED (0.0, 0.1375099, 0.0) RELATIVE bender7
COMPONENT bender9 = Guide_gravity(w1=.0355, h1=.020, w2=.0355, h2=.020, l=0.3245, nslit=9, d=.0005, mleft=1, mright=3, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 0.325) RELATIVE bender8 ROTATED (0.0, 0.1375099, 0.0) RELATIVE bender8
COMPONENT bender10 = Guide_gravity(w1=.0355, h1=.020, w2=.0355, h2=.020, l=0.3245, nslit=9, d=.0005, mleft=1, mright=3, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 0.325) RELATIVE bender9 ROTATED (0.0, 0.1375099, 0.0) RELATIVE bender9
COMPONENT lmonb = L_monitor(nL=140, filename="lmonB.dat", xmin=-0.018, xmax=0.018, ymin=-0.018, ymax=0.018, Lmin=0.0, Lmax=17.0, restore_neutron=1) AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.326) RELATIVE bender10

COMPONENT guide_in = Slit(xmin=-0.015, xmax=0.015, ymin=-.01, ymax=+.01) AT (0, 0, 0.2845) RELATIVE psd2 
COMPONENT guide_straight1 = Guide_gravity(w1=.030, h1=.020, w2=.030, h2=.020, l=1.985, mleft=1, mright=1, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 0.0075) RELATIVE guide_in 
COMPONENT guide_straight2 = Guide_gravity(w1=.030, h1=.020, w2=.030, h2=.020, l=1.985, mleft=1, mright=1, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 2.000) RELATIVE guide_straight1 
COMPONENT guide_straight3 = Guide_gravity(w1=.030, h1=.020, w2=.030, h2=.020, l=1.985, mleft=1, mright=1, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 2.000) RELATIVE guide_straight2 
COMPONENT guide_straight4 = Guide_gravity(w1=.030, h1=.020, w2=.030, h2=.020, l=1.985, mleft=1, mright=1, mtop=1, mbottom=1, wavy=0) AT (0, 0, 2.000) RELATIVE guide_straight3 
COMPONENT psd3 = PSD_monitor(nx=100, ny=100, filename="psd3.dat", xmin=-0.030, xmax=0.030, ymin=-0.030, ymax=0.030, restore_neutron=1) AT (0.0, 0.0, 7.999) RELATIVE guide_in 
COMPONENT aperture1 = Slit(xwidth=A1w, yheight=A1h) AT (0, 0, 8.000) RELATIVE guide_in 
COMPONENT lmonitor2 = L_monitor(nL=140, filename="lmonitor2.dat", xmin=-0.0155, xmax=0.0155, ymin=-0.0105, ymax=0.0105, Lmin=0.0, Lmax=17.0, restore_neutron=1) AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.651) RELATIVE aperture1 
COMPONENT S6 = Slit(radius=S6) AT (0, 0, 2.800) RELATIVE aperture1 
COMPONENT APERTURE2 = Slit(radius=A2) AT (0, 0, L1) RELATIVE aperture1 
COMPONENT lmon2 = L_monitor(nL=140, filename="lmonitor3.dat", xmin=-0.0075, xmax=0.0075, ymin=-0.0075, ymax=0.0075, Lmin=0.0, Lmax=17.0, restore_neutron=1) AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.285) RELATIVE APERTURE2 
COMPONENT psd4 = PSD_monitor(nx=100, ny=100, filename="psd4.dat", xmin=-0.0075, xmax=0.0075, ymin=-0.0075, ymax=0.0075) AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.286) RELATIVE APERTURE2 
END
